messages:
anya: Quick thread  launch post + webinar funnel SEO checklist. Need keyword buckets, JSON-LD snippets, internal linking inventory, redirect rules, and inbound lead routing. Can someone own the canonical map?

diego: I can take canonicals + redirect inventory. Plan: one canonical per intent (product, benchmark, webinar). I'll produce CSV old->new and mark experiment routes as 302. Recommend single-hop 301s for permanent moves.

sam: I'll own schema and structured data. Will add Event JSON-LD on webinar LP, FAQPage for benchmark post, and BreadcrumbList for longforms. Will supply CMS-ready snippets.

anya: CTA anchors we'll use: "Register", "Read the benchmark", "Get the starter kit". Two CTAs above the fold, tertiary CTAs inline. Keep anchors short and consistent.

mika: Tracking/routing: use utm_content values: webinar_cta / bench_cta / kit_cta. Map webinar_cta -> Sales A, bench_cta -> nurture. Instrument GA4 events: `cta_click`, `register_submit`, `lead_completed`. Thank-you pages = `noindex, nofollow` and excluded from sitemap.

diego: Example nginx rules I'll propose:
```
# migrate legacy article to canonical landing (direct 301)
rewrite ^/old-article/(.*)$ /launch-2026/$1 permanent;
# temporary experiment -> 302
rewrite ^/exp/.*$ /exp-reset$1 redirect;
# register fallback to LP
location /register { try_files $uri $uri/ /webinar-lp; }
```
I'll flag which are 301 vs 302 in the CSV.

sam: JSON-LD I'll add to CMS (example):
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood webinar: Serving at scale","startDate":"2026-06-12T17:00:00Z","eventStatus":"https://schema.org/EventScheduled","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar"}}
Also will add `mainEntity` FAQs for the benchmark page (top 5 Qs).

mika: Routing detail: persist utm_content across redirects via server-side session cookie so Sales receives the correct source. Also surface utm_content into lead payload to CRM.

diego: After CMS deploy, I'll run a staging crawl and produce a list of redirect chains. If any chain >1 hop, we'll flatten to a single 301 to preserve link equity.

seo-bot: Preview build created for branch `marketing/tactical-lp` - https://staging.redwood.ai/launch-preview - running structured data validation and staging crawl.

anya: Internal linking plan: add 2 contextual links from product docs and 3 links from the benchmark post to the canonical landing. Do not link to TY pages. Use rel="canonical" appropriately on duplicate variants.

sam: Also recommend adding `BreadcrumbList` to LP and internal pages to improve sitelinks. Will include snippet.

mika: I'll create Linear tickets for routing matrix + GA events and attach sample payloads for the CRM.

diego: Ownership recap: diego = canonical & redirects; sam = schema + JSON-LD; mika = UTMs + lead routing; anya = CTA copy + release signoff. Sync tomorrow 10:30 to review staging crawl results. :calendar:
